title: agent-fs verification
description: Checks that cover the whole crate. What each test checks is in src/.dev/verification.json and tests/.dev/verification.json; results are readings and live with CI.

entities.title: Tests on macOS and Linux
entities.summary: The unit and end-to-end tests run on both platforms the batched loaders are written for.
criteria: Every test passes on macOS (where aio.rs is compiled) and on Linux (where uring.rs is compiled)

checks.description: Matrix of macos-latest and ubuntu-latest, on every push to main and every pull request.

entities.title: Line and branch coverage of at least 95%
entities.summary: CI fails when the tests cover less than 95% of agent-fs's lines or branches.
criteria: At least 95% of lines covered (cargo llvm-cov --fail-under-lines 95)
At least 95% of branches covered, counted from the lcov BRDA records

checks.description: Runs on Linux only, so aio.rs is not part of the measured code.

entities.title: The built binary starts and answers
entities.summary: The release build prints its help and answers one request.

checks.description: The zazzle formula's test block (brew test zazzle): `afs --version` prints agent-fs.

entities.title: Builds with the workspace's minimum Rust
entities.summary: The crate compiles with Rust 1.85, the workspace's rust-version.
criteria: cargo check succeeds with the 1.85 toolchain
